items.title: Free Laptop Yojana
items.snippet_en: While some state governments in India offer free laptop schemes to meritorious students, there is no universal "Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme" for all students across the country. These state-level schemes often have specific eligibility criteria, such as academic performance and domicile requirements.
